title: Grateful Dead Live at Strand Lyceum on 1972-05-23

ai_review.summary: Excellent stereo soundboard capture of a smoking Dark Star → Morning Dew sequence with standout performances throughout the set.
ai_review.review: The partial May 23 1972 London show shines thanks to an epic Dark Star that flows flawlessly into a superb Morning Dew, plus a memorable Two Souls in Communion and a relaxed He's Gone. Reviewers rave about the crystal‑clear, hi‑fi soundboard mix, calling it a must‑have for any 1972 Dead collection.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviewers gave 5‑star ratings, praising both the musical performance (especially Dark Star → Morning Dew) and the pristine soundboard recording; thus a top‑tier rating is warranted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Stereo hi‑fi sound, excellent mix, crisp clarity throughout; no noted dropouts or balance issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong early Dark Star > Morning Dew segue, followed by solid second‑set material (He's Gone, Sugar Magnolia, Comes A Time) that reviewers describe as one of the better second sets of the tour.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's guitar accents and tone are highlighted as exceptional, cementing his status as a great lead‑singer/guitarist.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil Lesh's bass tone and solo receive specific praise for their depth and musicality.
